safety_review.findings: One claude-opus-5-5 reviewer that did not write the replies read every reply in all 13 banks, every option, all 3 alternatives, in Thai and English, against each bank's question variants. Sources opened: European guideline on major bleeding and coagulopathy following trauma, 6th ed. (Rossaint et al., Crit Care 2023, PMC9977110: Rec 13 systolic 80-90 mmHg without brain injury, Rec 15 restricted crystalloid, Rec 23 TXA within 3 h, 1 g over 10 min then 1 g over 8 h); CRASH-2 timing analysis (Lancet 2011, via secondary summaries: death from bleeding RR 0.68 within 1 h, 0.79 at 1-3 h, 1.44 after 3 h); Cyklokapron prescribing information (Pfizer, Medsafe: hypotension with rapid IV injection, no faster than 1 mL/min, so 1 g over 10 min). WHO Basic Emergency Care and Thai sources were not reopened; the case's own review cites them. Every TXA figure in the replies matches these sources. No reply reassures about a harmful action or delays needed treatment; no option is unsafe, so no safety sentence is needed. No reply ranks or grades an option, names an absent drug or test, or asks a question. Judged acceptable: the step3 option e weigh lines describe early clot breakdown and benefit within 3 h without naming TXA (the real gap in that option, not a step preview); the step3 option c weigh lines frame 1 L of saline as a ceiling, consistent with Rec 15 and the ATLS 10th ed. 1 L initial bolus. Non-blocking notes for a later edit: step3.b [1] calls near 90 a floor, while Rec 13 allows 80-90; step3.e en[1] strength says the two things he needs most (Thai has no most) and weigh says clot breakdown drives trauma bleeding (overstated; Thai says keeps it going); step2.W.a th[1] weigh adds trachea central, absent from the English and from question v2; step4.W.b [1] weigh says an hour in, stated only in question v1; step1.e [1] weigh lists talking and alert, which do not argue against neurogenic shock; step4.R.b [0] strength says blood only avoids dilution where the option line says limits; step3.e th[0] weigh uses a bare การชะลอ with no object, which could read as delay. Case-level, not a reply issue: on the path step3 e then step4.W b, c or d no TXA is ever given, which the case review's claim that TXA is loaded once on every path does not cover.
